summary: A powerful officeholder comes to campaign: {powerful officeholder} offers to campaign beside you, and will want something afterward.
realLife: Appointed to her late husband's Senate seat in 1931, Caraway faced a primary in 1932. Senator Huey Long of Louisiana toured Arkansas with her for a week, partly to gain influence in the home state of a rival, and she won easily.
gates: {powerful officeholder} is on record with a reason to want influence in your place.
weights: How weak your campaign is on the record.
How much {their rival} matters to your place.
choices: accept one event, not the tour
